Name: Caroline did not cheat
Author: Sistermods
Description:
I wouldn't say I like cheating.

However, there's a prevalent theory that Caroline cheated on Pierre, which is backed up by 4 in-game dialogues.

This mod edits those four dialogues to make it better fit either with the Emily is the wizard's daughter theory or Caroline is the wizard's daughter theory.

You can configure which one you want by changing the config in the file or using the Generic mod config menu.


Here are links to where I found out about those theories:
The Emily Theory: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/wax0u4/abigail_is_not_the_most_obvious_choice_for_the/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x&context=3]Abigail is not the most obvious choice for the wizard’s daughter and I'm tired of pretending she is : StardewValley (reddit.com)[/url]

The Caroline Theory: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/ou2vip/why_i_think_caroline_is_the_wizards_daughter/]Why I think Caroline is the wizard's daughter : StardewValley (reddit.com)[/url]


This mod was originally just for me, so characters may be OOC.

Also there's 2 new extra dialogue that I added for fun.

Manifest.Name: Caroline did not cheat!
Manifest.Description: Changes dialogue that indicates Caroline cheating on Pierre
Manifest.Author: OldestSis
